sc: THE FILES
Final. Final two. Final, actually final.
THE FILES
Quick question. Which one did you actually sign?
THE FILES
Everyone's got the contract. Not everyone's got the same one.
THE GAME
Let's play spot the difference. Three seconds each.
ROUND 1
Round one. Version three, and version four. Spotted it?
Thirty days became sixty. That's a month longer to get paid.
ROUND 2
Round two. Look closely.
One month's notice became three. That's two extra months you're locked in.
ROUND 3
Round three. The cap on what they'd pay if it goes wrong.
Now it's only the last three months' fees.
THE GAME
One word. One number. A different deal.
And nobody sent you a list of changes.
THE CATCH
Here's the catch. Lots of contracts have an entire agreement clause. It says the signed document is the whole deal.
So what you agreed in an email may not count.
THE CATCH
And clicking sign on a screen usually counts too.
The Law Commission says an electronic signature can be used to sign a document.
3 CHECKS
So before you sign, three quick checks.
3 CHECKS
One. Ask what's changed since the last version, in writing.
Two. Read the version you're signing, not the one you remember.
Three. Save the signed copy, dated, where everyone can find it.
THE FIX
That's what Dogetlawyer is for. Every contract in one place,
with the signed version on record, and the date it was signed. So nobody's working from final two.
THE FIX
One contract. One version.
